subject: Vendor activation checklist: privacy attestation, SOC 2 & PO routing
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novahealth.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, procurement@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novahealth.io
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Initiating onboarding for NovaHealth — docs attached?

Hi Markus / Redwood procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. As discussed, I'm starting the vendor onboarding for NovaHealth so we can get usage and metering flowing once the engineering integration is complete. I've attached a redacted copy of our latest SOC 2 report and a current subprocessor manifest.

Quick asks from our side: can you confirm the PO flow (who to send invoices to), and whether Redwood needs a fully-signed DPA before we can be marked active? We can sign the DocuSign envelope if you send the template.

Attachments: NovaHealth_SOC2_report_redacted_2026.pdf; nova_subprocessors_list_2026.csv

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
NovaHealth
elena@novahealth.io
+1 415-555-0198

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novahealth.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initiating onboarding for NovaHealth — docs attached?

Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the call yesterday. Quick context and next steps from procurement/security side: 

- We need a countersigned DPA on file before data processing begins. We can accept DocuSign or a scanned signature.
- SOC 2 redacted report looks fine as long as the control summary is included; our security team will run the link you sent through their checklist and may follow up with one or two clarifying questions about segmentation and key rotation.
- Please provide a CSV or spreadsheet that includes a point of contact for billing and the remit address — that lets us create the vendor record and route POs.

I've attached a short vendor onboarding checklist and a DPA template we typically use. Vanessa (cc) will own PO routing and invoice instructions. Karthik will be our security liaison if the SOC 2 review flags anything.

Can you confirm: 1) who the billing contact is, 2) if you can sign the attached DPA by EOD Wednesday (11/18)? Once we have the countersigned DPA and billing details we can create the PO path and set NovaHealth to Active-Pending-Bill so engineering can provision keys.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Vendor Ops — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist_v2.pdf; redwood_dpa_template_v1.docx

From: Elena Morales <elena@novahealth.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 07:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initiating onboarding for NovaHealth — docs attached?

Thanks Markus — see responses inline and files attached.

- Billing contact: Marissa Chen, marissa.chen@novahealth.io; remit address: NovaHealth, AP Dept, 120 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.
- DPA: I signed the DPA in DocuSign and attached a PDF copy (signed_dpa_nova-redwood_v1.pdf). Envelope ID: ABC12345.
- SOC 2: attaching the redacted PDF again for your security team.
- Subprocessors: attached CSV with current list and contact email for our vendor manager.

Attachments: signed_dpa_nova-redwood_v1.pdf; NovaHealth_SOC2_report_redacted_2026.pdf; nova_subprocessors_list_2026.csv

Let me know if you need anything else; we'd love to get a PO number so we can start scheduled provisioning next week.

Best,
Elena

Elena / Marissa — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. I see the signed DPA in DocuSign (envelope ABC12345) and the billing contact details. I've routed the vendor creation request to finance and requested a PO number; typical turnaround is 24–48 hours for a first-time supplier.

Vanessa: can you confirm the PO number here once created and advise invoice routing (e.g., ap@redwood.com, remit matching)? If finance needs anything else from NovaHealth we'll flag it directly.

Karthik: I'll send the SOC 2 link and subprocessors to the security checklist channel; if you need the unredacted report we can request it via Elena (we try to avoid storing full unredacted reports in drive).

Action items summary:
- Finance: create vendor record and issue PO (Vanessa)
- Security: complete SOC 2 checklist and confirm no outstanding controls questions (Karthik)
- Vendor: expect PO number and you may begin provisioning when vendor state is Active-Pending-Bill

Markus Klein
Head of Vendor Ops — Redwood Inference
